@claude What are the Science Museum's opening hours on Sundays, and what time does it open?

The Science Museum in London opens at **10:00 on Sundays** and closes at **18:00**. Last entry is 17:15, and some galleries start closing about 30 minutes before the museum does.

I could only open one source, [Ian Visits](https://www.ianvisits.co.uk/venues/science-museum/). It says the museum is open daily from 10am to 6pm, but it was last checked in December 2025. The Art Fund page wouldn't load for me, and I couldn't reach the museum's own site. Search listings, including [Art Fund](https://www.artfund.org/explore/museums-and-galleries/science-museum), also show 10:00–18:00. One listing, [Day Out With The Kids](https://www.dayoutwiththekids.co.uk/attractions/science-museum-2651488e), shows a 17:00 close.

Hours can change around holidays, so check the museum's website before you go.

@claude Does the Science Museum cafe in South Kensington open on Sundays, and if so what time? Also do we need to book a slot for the museum itself or can we just walk in?

**Café:** Yes, it's open on Sundays. Benugo lists the Gallery Café (Level 2) as open 11:00–16:00 on Sunday. I didn't find a booking requirement for it. Another Benugo listing, The Diner on the ground floor, shows the same Sunday hours, but I only saw that in a search snippet and didn't open the page. Hours can change, particularly in the holidays, so check before you go.

**Museum entry:** You should book. The museum's visit page says you need to pre-book a free ticket, and your arrival time slot is printed on it. The page doesn't mention walk-in entry, so I wouldn't count on it. On Sundays the museum is open 10:00–18:00, with last entry at 17:15. It's closed 24–26 December. Special exhibitions and IMAX cost extra.

I couldn't open the museum's own food and drink page, so the café hours come only from Benugo.

- [Benugo – The Diner](https://www.benugo.com/sites/cafes/the-diner/)
